# [TASK] Kubernetes manifests: Kustomize base + local/azure/aws overlays

## Task
Build the Kustomize structure from ARCHITECTURE.md §11.3 for all implemented services: base manifests plus local/azure/aws overlays.

## Parent Story
Parent: #88

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `base/` has Deployment+Service per service and StatefulSet+PVC for MongoDB, Redis, Postgres, with readiness/liveness probes and resource requests/limits on every workload
- [x] `overlays/local` covers all services; `overlays/azure`/`overlays/aws` cover the core slice (api-gateway + movie-service + MongoDB + Redis, per ADR-005 — Eureka/Config are never deployed to K8s, K8s Services + ConfigMaps replace them), with JVM `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=60 -Xss256k` and single replicas
- [x] `kubectl apply -k` succeeds per overlay — `local` verified on a live minikube cluster; `azure`/`aws` validated via `kubectl kustomize` dry-run (no cloud infra existed yet — that's #26/#27)
- [x] End-to-end movie request verified through the real local ingress path: `Ingress -> api-gateway -> movie-service -> MongoDB`, both the TMDB-shaped movie facade and person facade
- [x] No secrets committed in plaintext — each overlay's `secretGenerator` reads a gitignored `secrets.env`; only `secrets.env.example` templates are committed

## Estimate
**Hours:** 10

## Notes
`infrastructure/kubernetes/{deployments,services,configmaps,secrets}` (directories an earlier plan expected to migrate) never existed in this repo's git history — nothing to migrate.

Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §11.3
